task: Fix a real INV-10-adjacent bug: every transcription failure message was written only to #status, which lives inside the closed <dialog id="settingsPanel">, so the rail badge said 'Problem' while the reason was unreadable

public/controller/view.js.summary: updateStatus now writes THREE surfaces, not two: #status, the rail badge (dot + word), and -- new -- #railNote whenever level is 'problem'. Added showRailProblem/clearRailProblem (module-private): a problem note is sticky (no auto-hide timer, unlike flashRailNote), carries the .is-problem class, and is cleared the moment a non-problem level arrives. The mirroring block sits ABOVE the 'same level -> return' early-out on purpose, so a second, differently-worded problem message still updates the note even though the badge does not change. flashRailNote now clears railProblemNote and .is-problem so a Clear/Undo flash takes over cleanly instead of layering on a sticky note. updateStatus gained an injectable clearTimeoutFn option for tests.

public/styles/controls.css.summary: Added .railNote.is-problem { color: #ff453a } -- the same chrome literal as .railStatusDot.is-level-problem (--clear-danger is declared inside a clear-button rule and is not in scope on .railNote).

test/public/controller/view.test.js.summary: createStatusCtx gained a railNote node. Five new tests: problem text is mirrored into the note; a repeated problem at the same level still updates it; recovery clears text/class/state; the problem note sets no auto-hide timer; flashRailNote takes over from a sticky note.

flow_impact: Updates the 'status' flow: it now carries one call -> three DOM writes, and updateStatus no longer no-ops unconditionally on a repeated identical level (problem-level text still reaches #railNote). map.json's status-flow invariant clause was corrected in the same change.
known_limitation: On DESKTOP with the rail collapsed (html.is-rail-collapsed, 64px), layout.css:301 hides .railNote and the mobile <=900px block does not apply, so the reason is still unreadable in that one configuration. Not a regression (there was no note at all before) but the INV-10 symptom survives there. Deliberately left open pending Steve's call -- an attempted CSS exemption was tried and reverted: at 64px the text wraps to roughly one character per line.
